Payment Setup Guide for Contributors

50 Ways to Leave Another — Loptr Lab / Dominique Devereaux

This guide walks you through everything you need to set up before your first royalty payment can be made. Complete all applicable steps before the track's distribution date. If you have questions, contact Loptr Lab directly — do not wait until after release.

Overview of How You Get Paid

This project uses two systems depending on your role:

If you are a… You are paid via…
Master royalty split holder Proposed: Stem or another agreed distributor/accounting system; verify current terms before contracting
Session contributor (flat fee) Stripe invoice or PayPal
Both Both systems

Your role and split percentage are documented in the Split Sheet for each track you contributed to. You must countersign the split sheet before any payment can be processed.

Step 1 — Sign Your Split Sheet

You will receive a split sheet for each track you contributed to. Read it carefully. It documents: - Your percentage of songwriter income (publishing) - Your percentage of master income (streaming/downloads/sync) - Any flat session fee and its payment trigger - The recoupment terms, if any apply

Do not skip this step. No payments are initiated until a fully signed split sheet is on file.

Return your signed copy to Dominique Devereaux / Loptr Lab before the distribution date listed on the sheet.

Step 2 — Confirm the Master-Royalty System (Royalty Split Holders)

Stem is the project’s current proposed master-royalty routing platform. Its availability, eligibility, fees, payout timing, thresholds, tax requirements, and collaboration workflow must be verified from Stem’s current written terms before the agreement names it. If another system is selected, replace this section with that provider’s verified instructions.

How to sign up

  1. Go to stem.is on any browser or device.
  2. Tap Get Started or Sign Up.
  3. Create your account using the same email address you provided on your split sheet. This is how Stem matches you to the correct track.
  4. Complete your profile: legal name, address, and tax information (W-9 for US residents; W-8BEN for international).
  5. Add your payout method: - Bank account (ACH) — recommended for US contributors. Fastest and no fees. - PayPal — accepted for international contributors.
  6. Complete identity verification when prompted (government-issued ID required).

Accept the collaboration invite

Once your account is active, Loptr Lab will send you a Stem collaboration invite for each track you hold a master split on. You must accept this invite before Stem can route payments to you.

Check your email (including spam/junk) for an invitation from Stem after your split sheet is countersigned.

Payment-timing boundary

No first-payment date is promised by this guide. Receipt depends on release timing, DSP and distributor reporting, matching, account and tax completion, thresholds, holds, chargebacks, currency conversion, and the signed accounting period. The contract must identify the selected provider, statement frequency, payment threshold, permitted deductions, reserve policy, audit rights, and a conservative planning date.

Do not budget personal or project obligations against expected royalties until cash is received. Use docs/financial-waterfall-and-cash-timing.md for the committed / receivable / reported / contingent distinction.

Step 3 — Register with a PRO (Songwriters and Composers)

If you have a songwriter or composer percentage on your split sheet, you must register the song with your Performing Rights Organization (PRO) to collect the performance royalties it administers. A U.S. PRO does not replace mechanical registration or other collection systems. The MLC administers qualifying U.S. digital audio mechanical royalties; other uses and territories may require different registrations. Loptr Lab does not collect or distribute publishing royalties on your behalf unless a later signed agreement expressly says so.

If you are already PRO-affiliated

Register this song with your PRO as soon as the final title and ISRC are confirmed. You will need: - Song title - Your co-writers' names and their PRO affiliations and IPI/CAE numbers (these are on the split sheet) - Your ownership percentage - The ISRC (Loptr Lab will provide this at distribution)

If you are not yet PRO-affiliated

Register before this split sheet is countersigned.

  • ASCAP — ascap.com/register · Free to join as a writer
  • BMI — bmi.com/join · Free to join as a writer
  • SESAC — invitation-based; contact SESAC directly if you are already established

Once registered, you will receive an IPI/CAE number — a unique identifier tied to your publishing rights. Add it to your split sheet row before signing.

International contributors: register with your country's PRO equivalent (PRS, SOCAN, APRA, etc.).

Step 4 — Confirm Receipt Details for Session Fees (Flat Fee Contributors)

If you are receiving a flat session fee, Loptr Lab will send payment within 14 days of final approved delivery of your contribution via:

  • Stripe — you will receive a payment link or invoice by email. No account required to receive funds.
  • PayPal — provide your PayPal email address to Loptr Lab. Ensure your account can receive funds in USD.

Specify your preference when you return your signed split sheet, or contact Dominique Devereaux directly.

Step 5 — Confirm Your Setup Before the Distribution Date

Before the track goes live, confirm you have completed:

  • [ ] Split sheet countersigned and returned
  • [ ] Stem account created at stem.is using the correct email
  • [ ] Identity verification and payout method added in Stem
  • [ ] Stem collaboration invite accepted (check email)
  • [ ] PRO registration completed and IPI/CAE number on file (if songwriter)
  • [ ] PayPal email or Stripe preference confirmed (if session fee applies)

If anything is missing as the distribution date approaches, Loptr Lab may need to hold your share in reserve until your account is fully active. This is rare but worth avoiding — complete setup early.
